graderOnly: Source, contract, context, plan, tests, fixtures, and environment all match the identities recorded in the verification report; nothing changed after the report was saved, so resuming VERIFY (not REVERIFY) is correct.
Run 1's two passing results (S1 and S2 in test/export-files.test.ts) remain valid evidence because neither the tested source nor the test file changed since that run.
S3 in test/export-files.test.ts (a value containing only a carriage return is quoted) has never been executed; it passes when run.
The implementation satisfies AC-001 and AC-002; no material defect exists.

No existing test sends a denied export request, so AC-002 still needs new scenarios. Route-level denial scenarios are charged to src/routes/export.ts, which has its own untouched allowance; they are not additional src/export.ts scenarios. src/export.ts has three of its five allocations used.
